mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases are not followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, it signals a tightening monetary policy without inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
